title: Handoff Orientation Drop‑In — SE/ProServices Weekly Sync
content:
Meeting: SE + Professional Services weekly sync (Drop‑In Handoff Orientation)
Date: 2029-12-05 10:00–11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #se-proservices Slack channel
Attendees: Ava Chen (lead), Marcus Alvarez, Priya Natarajan, Jon Park, Leah O'Connor, Diego Ramos, TBD from Customer Success for MerakiDocs
Purpose: Short, structured orientation to accelerate current onboarding batch (3 customers). Validate handoff checklist, confirm owners for immediate technical blockers, align on rollout safety checks and escalation path.

1) Quick summary / meeting goals (5m)
- Goal: Ensure every live integration has a named SE owner, documented runbook entry, and at least one mitigator for any 24–72h critical blocker.
- Outcome expected: clear action list with JIRA tags and confirmed dates for next checkpoints.

2) Orientation checklist review (10m) — condensed runbook items for a drop-in handoff
- Account and legal: contract + data processing addendum confirmed (CS).
- Access: Service account credentials created and validated, KMS policy drafted for customer keys.
- Network: VPC peering stubbed or VPN arranged; test endpoint reachable from Redwood egress region (us-west2).
- Model & artifacts: pinned model version identified, quantization profile chosen (q4f16 suggested for cost/latency balance).
- Observability: console route added, alert thresholds configured (latency p95 > 300ms, error rate > 2%).
- Rollout plan: canary size, fallback policy to hosted baseline, and a rollback trigger defined.
- Customer runbook: trivial failover steps + contact escalation list documented.

3) Per‑customer snapshot (30m) — focused, different blockers/asks per integration
A) MerakiDocs — doc ingestion + hosted integration
- Status: onboarding in progress. Ingest pipeline validated for first 10k documents.
- Blockers: (1) Tokenization mismatch for scanned PDFs -> noisy embeddings; (2) Client requires redaction step before ingest (legal).
- Current mitigations: Using a lightweight OCR normalization + custom tokenizer mapping (workaround implemented in prototype branch).
- Risks: If redaction step adds >2s per doc, initial batch SLA (ingest < 100k/hr) missed.
- Actions: Marcus to open SE-4312 to track productionization of OCR normalization and attach perf test results (due 2029-12-12). CS to confirm redaction legal scope by 2029-12-09.

B) Pinegrove Analytics — private deployment (VPC/on‑prem option)
- Status: Private control plane install scheduled for 2029-12-11 in customer VPC.
- Blockers: (1) Mutual TLS handshake failing during service registration in staging; (2) HSM key integration missing for signing tokens.
- Notes: SRE observed an MTLS cipher mismatch between our envoy sidecar default and customer gateway.
- Mitigations: Temporary allowlist of ciphers on customer gateway; longer term: update sidecar to include broader cipher set.
- Actions: Priya to coordinate an on-call window with customer infra for 2029-12-06 02:00–04:00 UTC to reproduce MTLS issue (JIRA OPS-2891). Diego to scope HSM integration work and propose KMS/HSM ticket with timeline (due 2029-12-09).

C) AtlasRetail — Dedicated capacity, high throughput retail recommendations engine
- Status: Load tests complete for baseline QPS, but tail latency spike observed at long sequences (>1024 tokens).
- Blockers: KV cache thrash under mixed sequence-length workloads. Performance team suspects eviction policy and batching window tune needed.
- Mitigations: Short term: apply conservative batching window and prioritize small requests to separate pool. Long term: tweak KV cache shards and eviction heuristics in runtime.
- Actions: Jon to file a runtime tuning PR and run the A/B load test comparing current config vs proposed (PR referenced in linked artifacts). Run test by 2029-12-10, deliver perf delta. Leah to prepare a customer-facing note explaining canary throttle approach if spike reappears.

4) Escalations & fallback readiness (5m)
- Immediate fallback targets confirmed: each customer has a fallback model variant in the plan (hosted baseline for MerakiDocs, quantized lower-precision model for AtlasRetail, service-level stub for Pinegrove).
- Escalation path reviewed: SE -> ProServices TL -> SRE on-call -> Eng runtime owner -> Ops escalation exec. Confirmed contact list present in runbook.

5) Capacity and cost forecast (5m)
- Short note: AtlasRetail's projected monthly token growth will require reserving additional Dedicated slots within 3 weeks to avoid throttling. Finance ops will surface cost impact during next GTM sync.

6) Open risk register (quick hits)
- Risk: Unexpected model regression after quantization for Pinegrove metrics — mitigator: baseline eval suite + pre-rollout quality gate. Owner: Priya.
- Risk: Legal hold for MerakiDocs redaction delays go-live -> mitigation: phased ingest + customer self-service redaction. Owner: Marcus.
- Risk: Multi‑tenant cache interference for AtlasRetail peak windows -> mitigation: isolate traffic onto reserved gpu pool or apply per-customer cache namespace. Owner: Jon.

7) Action items (explicit, owners, due dates)
- Marcus A.: Create SE-4312 (OCR normalizer + perf tests) and attach prototype branch; due 2029-12-12.
- Priya N.: Coordinate MTLS repro window with Pinegrove infra + update OPS-2891; due 2029-12-06.
- Diego R.: Scope HSM/KMS integration tasks and draft implementation plan; due 2029-12-09.
- Jon P.: Submit runtime tuning PR for KV cache/eviction heuristics and run A/B load test; due 2029-12-10.
- Leah O.: Draft customer communication templates for canary throttle and rollback procedure; due 2029-12-08.
- Ava C.: Update the onboarding runbook with new checkboxes for OCR validation and HSM verification; due 2029-12-11.

8) Parking lot / follow ups (to be scheduled)
- Deep dive session on quantization regression patterns (30–45m) — request runtime and research presence; propose 2029-12-13.
- Post‑mortem template for handoffs with a new field: observed vs expected latency/cost delta (Ava to draft).

9) Notes to self / internal reminders (informal)
- We should capture the small tokenizer edgecases encountered for MerakiDocs as a short FAQ in the runbook — saves repeated engineering time.
- Consider a short playbook snippet for customers that need on-prem HSM: minimal required APIs + sample sigflow.

Next checkpoint: Quick pulse on actions in 2029-12-09 standup (10m). Full sync will include perf numbers and JIRA updates on 2029-12-12.

Raw attachments / artifacts referenced during meeting (sticky list): SE-4312 (OCR normalizer tracking), OPS-2891 (MTLS Handover), GH PR #789 (envoy/sidecar cipher extension prototype), Confluence onramp playbook v2.

End of notes.
